deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a specific spatial description ('lies next to') that the text does not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: this is actually circumspect and very separate
considerations.reason: The rewrite replaces 'circumspect' with the standard pathological term 'circumscribed'. This corrects an obvious mishearing or slip of the tongue and does not harm student learning.

considerations.reason: The rewrite renders 'So you can see again' as 'therefore', which preserves the lecturer's inference that the separation during tissue preparation demonstrates the tumour's circumscribed boundary.
